title: E-commerce Website Template Freebie
description: A free e-commerce website template with a modern, tech-forward design. Used by front-end development educators as a teaching example for students to build in code. The design features a clean, structured layout ideal for electronics, gadgets, or general retail. The hero section uses a split layout with product imagery on one side and value proposition text with CTA on the other. Product categories are displayed as icon cards in a grid. The product listing page includes filter sidebar (price range, brand, rating, availability) and a sortable grid view. Product detail includes image gallery thumbnails, specifications table, related products carousel, and review section with star ratings. Cart uses a clean table layout. The design uses a blue primary with clean white backgrounds. Typography uses a modern sans-serif throughout. Built with Figma auto-layout and component-based structure for easy customization. The template is fully responsive.
primary_use_case: Great for general e-commerce stores selling electronics, gadgets, or consumer goods — also used as a front-end development teaching resource.
style_vibe: Clean, tech-forward e-commerce with blue accents and structured filter sidebar — ideal for electronics and general retail with a focus on usability.
